items.title: Full-stack product engineering
items.summary: From schema to screen: React and Next.js frontends on Node, NestJS and PostgreSQL, with payments, real-time chat and the performance work that takes a 27s response down to 3.5s.

items.title: Backend and platform architecture
items.summary: Layered APIs (routes → controller → service → repository), Zod contracts, CASL permissions, audit trails and background queues that stay readable as the team grows.

items.title: AI systems and autonomous agents
items.summary: LLM pipelines that return validated, structured data rather than prose, plus multi-agent workflows with tools, tracing and budgets.

items.title: RAG and vector search
items.summary: Retrieval over your own documents with Pinecone-style vector search, so answers cite sources instead of guessing.

items.title: Cloud deployment and production delivery
items.summary: Shipping to AWS, Azure and Vercel with pipelines that test before they deploy.
